ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the sexual-harassment allegation: preserve trip/telemetry records, collect the rider's detailed statement and any evidence, interview the driver, and advise the rider of the RydeHELP reporting path (and 995 if she needs assistance).
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is "safety" and the rider complaint alleges harassment (unwanted comments about her body and a request for her phone number). Per SAFE-1 (and the system's mandatory-escalation rule for safety disputes / harassment keywords), no automated ruling may be issued; the case is referred to a human reviewer with a factual summary.
